chunks.content: The Transformer architecture relies entirely on self-attention mechanisms to compute representations of its input and output without using sequence-aligned RNNs or convolution.

Multi-Head Attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions. Scaled dot-product attention computes softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))V.
Positional encodings of sinusoidal frequencies are added to input embeddings to inject positional order information into the non-recurrent attention layers.
Global mean surface temperature in 2023 reached approximately 1.45 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial baselines, driven predominantly by anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions.
Renewable energy adoption grew by 24 percent in 2023, with solar photovoltaic and wind energy capacity additions exceeding historical projections worldwide.
pgvector adds vector similarity search capabilities to PostgreSQL supporting exact kNN and approximate nearest neighbor indexing via HNSW and IVFFlat indexes.
The HNSW index in pgvector uses hierarchical navigable small world graphs with vector_cosine_ops, vector_l2_ops, and vector_ip_ops distance operators.
Full-text search in PostgreSQL uses tsvector and tsquery data types along with ts_rank and ts_rank_cd for cover density relevance scoring.
The Raft consensus algorithm decomposes state machine replication into leader election, log replication, and safety guarantees for distributed fault tolerance.
Paxos ensures consensus across asynchronous networks with unreliable communication through prepare, promise, accept, and commit phases.
Shor's algorithm provides polynomial time integer factorization using quantum Fourier transforms to find periods in modular exponentiation functions.
Grover's search algorithm provides quadratic speedup for unstructured database search queries, evaluating N items in O(sqrt(N)) oracle queries.
